messages:
maya (DevEx): quick preflight pulse before we lock: changelog cutoff at EOD, sampleapps linting, and SDK publish. who owns final sampleapp fixes?

sam (DevEx Eng): I can take overall owner for the quickstarts.
- changelog cutoff: confirmed EOD PST. I'll tag PRs that need entries.
- sdk publish: blocked on one failing integ test in native-go binding (see jenna).

carlos (Docs): Docs freeze at 18:00 PST. I'm queued on the site build; if any sample API surface changes land after that we need manual patches. PR 8532 is the last doc change I'm planning to ship.

jenna (QA): failing test details: sampleapp auth-e2e flakes on CI. Repro locally with:

```
make test-sampleapps AUTH_PROVIDER=local
# failure trace
--- FAIL: TestAuthFlow (0.12s)
    auth_test.go:47: expected token, got empty
```

Root cause looks like intermittent local KMS stub not returning keys during cold-starts. Seen this 6/12 runs. Filing ticket now.

alex (Eng): quick mitigation: add short retry around KMS fetch (3 retries, 200ms backoff) in sampleapp harness. I'll open a tiny PR and mark as hotfix. If we keep flaky it will block SDK publish.

sam (DevEx Eng): thanks alex — please assign to me when ready. I'll coordinate keeping the changelog entry minimal: "sampleapp: improve KMS retry to avoid CI flakes".

deploy-bot: automated-check: docker image scans completed, no high severity vulns. CI queue ETA ~12m.

maya (DevEx): action items capture: 
- alex: PR with KMS retry (owner: alex) — target +2hrs.
- jenna: open ticket with failed logs and mark regression label (owner: jenna) — done while we wait.
- sam: assemble changelog slice and stamp SDK publish checklist once CI green (owner: sam).
- carlos: hold doc freeze until we see final SDK API surface; if anything changes we'll patch manually.

can everyone react with :eye: when you see the PR or :shipit: when CI is green and we can cut the release?
